verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt's notarization flow includes its own remote signer identity verification via eID or video (a form of ID check), and its API lets businesses manage signers on notarization requests. However, nothing shows a legal-ops lead can configure or require stronger verification levels per sensitive document, and SMS and knowledge-based methods are not mentioned. Missing for 10: per-document configurable verification requirements, SMS verification, knowledge-based authentication, detailed docs on the identity-verification flow, independent corroboration.
